Masu binciken jagorori sun ce hakan na iya kawo gano cutar kansa, tarin fuka, HIV da zazzabin cizon sauro ga marasa lafiya a kasashe masu karamin karfi, inda adadin rayuwa ga cututtuka irin su kansar nono zai iya zama rabin na kasashe masu arziki.
JAS 39C Gripen ya yi hatsari a kan filin tashi da saukar jiragen sama da misalin karfe 9:30 na safe agogon gida (0230 UTC) kuma ya fashe, yana rufe filin jirgin sama zuwa jiragen kasuwanci.
An bayyana matukin jirgin a matsayin Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee.
Kafofin yada labarai na gida sun ruwaito cewa wata motar kashe gobara ta yi karo da ita yayin da take mayar da martani.
Vidal mai shekaru 28 ya koma kungiyar ta Barça a kakar wasa uku da ta gabata, daga Sevilla.
Tun bayan komawarsa birnin Catalan, Vidal ya buga wa kulob din wasanni 49.
An fara zanga-zangar ne da misalin karfe 11:00 agogon gida (UTC+1) a kan Whitehall dake fuskantar shiga Downing Street, fadar Firayim Minista.
Bayan 11:00, masu zanga-zanga sun toshe zirga-zirga a kan motar jirgin sama a Whitehall.
A 11:20, 'yan sanda sun nemi masu zanga-zangar su koma kan titin, suna cewa suna bukatar daidaita haƙƙin yin zanga-zanga da ginin motoci.

A kusan 11:29, zanga-zangar ta tashi daga Whitehall, ta wuce Trafalgar Square, a kan Strand, ta wuce Aldwych kuma ta hau Kingsway zuwa Holborn inda Jam'iyyar Conservative ta rike ta taron bazata a otal din Grand Connaught Rooms.
Kwararren mai buga wasan da aka yi da Nadal a Kanada ya ci 7-2.
Kwanan nan ya rasa Raonic a Brisbane Open.
Nadal ya samu kashi 88% a raga a wasan da ya lashe maki 76 a wasan farko.
Bayan wasan, Sarkin Clay ya ce, "Ina farin ciki ne kawai don dawowa a zagayen ƙarshe na abubuwan da suka fi muhimmanci. Ina nan don in yi ƙoƙarin lashe wan."
"Panama Papers" kalma ce ta laima ga takardu kimanin miliyan goma daga kamfanin shari'ar Panama Mossack Fonseca, wanda aka fallasa ga manema labarai a cikin bazara na 2016.
Takardun sun nuna bankuna goma sha hudu ne suka taimaka wa masu kudi masu kudi su boye biliyoyin dalar Amurka na dukiya don gujewa haraji da sauran kaidoji.
Jaridar The Guardian ta Birtaniya ta ba da shawarar cewa Deutsche Bank ta mallaki kusan kashi ɗaya bisa uku na kamfanonin shell 1200 da ake amfani da su don cimma wan.
An yi zanga-zanga a duk duniya, an yi tuhumar masu aikata laifuka da dama, kuma shugabannin gwamnatocin Iceland da Pakistan duk sun yi murabus.
An haife shi a Hong Kong, Ma ya yi karatu a Jami'ar New York da Harvard Law School kuma ya taba zama mazaunin dindindin na Amurka "green card".
Hsieh ya nuna a lokacin zaben cewa Ma na iya gudu daga kasar a lokacin da ake cikin rikici.
Hsieh ya kuma yi jayayya cewa Ma mai daukar hoto ya fi salon abu.
Duk da wadan zarge-zarge, Ma ya yi nasara a hannu a kan wani dandali mai fafutukar kulla dangantaka mai zurfi da kasar Sin.
Dan wasan yau na ranar shine Alex Ovechkin na Washington Capitals.
Ya ci kwallaye 2 da kuma taimako 2 a wasan da Washington ta yi nasara a kan Atlanta Thrashers da ci 5-3.
Ovechkin na farko na dare shine a kan kwallon da Nicklas Backstrom ya ci.

kwallonsa ta biyu a cikin dare ita ce ta 60 na kakar wasa, inda ya zama dan wasa na farko da ya ci kwallaye 60 ko fiye a kakar wasa tun 1995-96, lokacin da Jaromir Jagr da Mario Lemieux suka kai wan matsayi.
Batten ya kasance na 190 a jerin 2008 Richest Americans da aka yi da kimanin dala biliyan 2.3.
Ya kammala karatunsa a Kwalejin Fasaha da Kimiyya ta Jami'ar Virginia a shekarar 1950 kuma ya kasance babban mai ba da gudummawa ga cibiyar.
An kona gidan yarin Abu Ghraib na kasar Iraki yayin wata tarzoma
Gidan yarin ya yi kaurin suna bayan an gano cin zarafin fursunoni a can bayan da sojojin Amurka suka karbi mulki.
Piquet Jr. ya yi hatsari a cikin 2008 Singapore Grand Prix bayan da aka tsaya da Fernando Alonso a farko, wanda ya fitar da motar aminci.
A yayin da motocin da ke gaban Alonso suka shiga domin amfani da man fetur a karkashin motar lafiya, sai ya tashi a kan fakitin ya dauki nasara.
An kori Piquet Jr. bayan gasar Grand Prix ta Hungary ta 2009.
A daidai 8:46 a.m. wani hush ya fada a cikin birnin, wanda ke nuna ainihin lokacin da jirgin farko ya kai ga burinsa.
An yi wa wasu haske biyu wuta don su haskaka sararin sama.
Ana ci gaba da gina gine-gine guda biyar a wurin, tare da cibiyar sufuri da wurin tunawa a tsakiyar.
Shirin PBS yana da lambar yabo ta Emmy fiye da dubu biyu, kuma gudanar da shi ya fi tsawo kawai fiye da Sesame Street da Unguwar Mister Rogers.
Kowane kashi na shirin zai mai da hankali kan wani maƙala a cikin takamaiman littafi sannan kuma ya bincika wannan maƙala ta hanyar labarai da yawa.
Kowane shiri zai kuma ba da shawarwari ga littattafan da ya kamata yara su nemi lokacin da suka je laburaren su.
John Grant, daga WNED Buffalo (gidan gidan Reading Rainbow) ya ce "Reading Rainbow ya koya wa yara dalilin karatu, ... ƙaunar karatu - [nuni] ya ƙarfafa yara su ɗauki littafi kuma su karanta."
Wasu suna ganin cewa, ciki har da John Grant, duk da cewa, rashin kudi da kuma canjin falsafar shirye-shiryen talabijin na ilimi sun taimaka wajen kawo karshen jerin shirye-shiryen.
Guguwar, wacce ke da nisan mil 645 (1040 km) yamma da tsibirin Cape Verde, mai yiwuwa ta tsallake kafin ta yi barazanar yin barazana ga kowane yanki na kasa, masu hasashen zai ce.
A halin yanzu, Fred yana da iska mai nisan mil 105 a kowace awa (165 km/h) kuma yana tafiya zuwa arewa maso yamma.

Fred shine mafi ƙarfi da girgije mai zafi da aka yi aiki a yanzu haka kudu da gabas a cikin Atlantic tun lokacin da tauraron dan adam ya zo, kuma shine guda uku na guguwa a karo na farko a gabashin 35 ° W.
A ranar 24 ga Satumba, 1759, Arthur Guinness ya rattaba hannu kan haya na shekara 9,000 don St James' Gate Brewery a Dublin, Ireland.
Shekaru 250 bayan haka, Guinness ya girma zuwa kasuwancin duniya wanda ke juya yuro biliyan 10 (US$14.7 biliyan) kowace shekara.
Jonny Reid, mai hawa mota na tawagar A1GP New Zealand, a yau ya kafa tarihi ta hanyar tuka gidan gidan Auckland Bridge mai shekaru 48, New Zealand, bisa doka.
Mr Reid ya yi nasarar tuka motar A1GP ta New Zealand, Black Beauty a cikin sauri sama da 160km/h sau bakwai a kan gadar.

Yan sandan New Zealand sun samu matsala wajen amfani da bindigogin radar na saurin su don ganin yadda Mr Reid ke gudu saboda yadda Black Beauty ta yi kasa, kuma lokacin da yan sanda suka samu damar yin agogo baya Mr Reid shine lokacin da ya yi kasa zuwa 160km/h.

Bayan shekaru 250, Guinness ya bunƙasa zuwa wani kasuwancin duniya da ke samun sama da biliyan 10 na euro (US$14.7 biliyan) kowace shekara.
Jonny Reid, direba ne na kungiyar A1GP New Zealand, a yau ya kafa tarihi da yayi tuƙi mafi gudu a kan gadar Aukland Harbor mai shekaru 48, New Zealand, wanda bai keta doka ba.
Mista Reid ya yi ƙoƙarin tuƙa motar A1GP, Black Beauty ta New Zealand, a gudu na sama da 160km / h sau bakwai a bisa gadar.

Ƴan sandan New Zealand sun sami matsalar yin amfani da bindigoginsu na radar masu sauri don gane irin gudun da Mr Reid ya ke yi, saboda yanda Black Beauty take da gajarta, kuma lokaci ɗaya da ƴan sandan suka yi nasarar auna gudun Mr Reid shine lokacin da ya rage gudu zuwa 160km / h.
